These exercises practise vector and matrix operations by hand. \textbf{Show every step} so that partial answers can be graded.

\section{Vector Matrix Calculations}
\begin{enumerate}
\item Let $\mathbf{v}$ be the vector $[-2, b, 7, 2, a]^T$. Compute $\mathbf{v}^T\mathbf{v}$ and $\mathbf{v}\mathbf{v}^T$.
\item Let $A$ and $B$ be the following matrices
\[ A = \begin{bmatrix} -5 & 4 & -6 \\ 3 & 4 & -6 \\ 8 & -6 & 8 \end{bmatrix}, \quad B = \begin{bmatrix} -4 & 8 \\ -5 & -9 \\ 4 & -7 \end{bmatrix} \]
Compute $\mathbf{v} = B.[x,y]^T$, $\mathbf{w} = A.\mathbf{v}$. Then compute $C = A.B$ and $\mathbf{z} = C.[x,y]^T$.
\item Let $A$ be the matrix:
\[ A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -1 & -1 \\ 8-x & x-6 & x-6 \\ x-7 & 5-x & 5-x \end{bmatrix} \]
Compute respectively $A^2 = A.A$ and $A^3 = A.A.A$. Such a matrix $A$ is called \emph{nilpotent}.
\end{enumerate}

\section{Inline math}
Let $x_i^2 + y_{ij} = e^{x^2}$ and $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}^n$ with $\mathcal{L}(\theta) \leq \infty$.
The inverse $A^{-1}$ exists, $f'(x) = \sin x + \log(2x)$, and $\|\mathbf{w}\| \cdot |a| \to 0$.
Text has special characters: 50\% of \$5 \& \#1 under\_score.
A fraction $\frac{a}{b+1}$ inline, a root $\sqrt{x+1}$, the interval $[0, 1)$ and $\beta_1, \beta_2 \in [0, 1)$.
We write $a \neq b$, $x \notin A$, $x \cong y$, $\overline{z}$ and $\underline{w}$.

\subsection{Display math}
Consider
\[ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{\sqrt{x_i}} = \int_0^1 e^{-x^2} \, dx \]
and the matrices
\[ M = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix}, \quad D = \begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix}, \quad \hat{x} + \bar{y} + \vec{v}. \]
Cases:
\[ f(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & x > 0 \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \]
Aligned:
\begin{align*}
a &= b + c \\
  &= d
\end{align*}
A numbered equation:
\begin{equation}
\mathrm{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V = \lim_{n \to \infty} \max_x \det A
\end{equation}
\begin{itemize}
\item First item with $\int_0^1 x\,dx$.
\item Second item.
\end{itemize}
